   SOUTHEAST RESOURCE RECOVERY

  TUESDAY, MARCH 4, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

A motion was made by Board Member Allen, to elect Board Member Jones for Chair of
Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF). The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  4  Allen, Jones, Supernaw, Duggan
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Absent:  1  Wood

A motion was made by Board Member Jones, to elect Board Member Allen for Vice Chair of
Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF). The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  4  Allen, Jones, Supernaw, Duggan
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Absent:  1  Wood

Chair Duggan declared the nominations open for Chair.

Board Member Allen nominated Board Member Jones as Chair of Southeast Resource Recovery
Facility (SERRF).

There being no further nominations, Chair Duggan declared the nominations closed for Chair.

Board Member Jones accepted the Chair of Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF).

Chair Duggan declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Board Member Jones nominated Board Member Allen as Vice Chair of Southeast Resource
Recovery Facility (SERRF).

There being no further nominations, Chair Duggan declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

Board Member Allen accepted the Vice Chair of Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF).

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment or non-agenda public comment emails received.

ADJOURNMENT

At 4:18 PM, there being no objection, Chair Duggan declared the meeting adjourned.
